maddeler.e:
أتصبصب (form IIq)
# أَتَصَبْصَبُ (ʔataṣabṣabu) /ʔa.ta.sˤab.sˤa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
# أَتَصَبْصَبَ (ʔataṣabṣaba) /ʔa.ta.sˤab.sˤa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
# أَتَصَبْصَبْ (ʔataṣabṣab) /ʔa.ta.sˤab.sˤab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
